description: Synthetic commit messages for the six Prosecheck semantic rules.

cases.message: Reject expired session cookies

Keep invoice retries across worker restarts

Deployments previously discarded queued retries. The worker now restores them before it accepts new jobs.

Preserve OAuth state during SAML redirects

The identity provider can return through a second domain. A signed state value keeps the original login request valid.

Prevent duplicate charges after payment retries

PAY-184 records the gateway race that caused two workers to submit the same charge. A shared key now rejects the second request.

Return resident searches when one building is offline

A failed building query no longer cancels results from available buildings. The change updates search.go and building_client.go.

Reject lease imports without a property ID

Property matching by name linked leases to the wrong buildings. Callers must now provide the stable property ID.

Limit login attempts to five per account

The lower limit reduces password guessing without blocking normal typing errors.
cases.diff:
diff --git a/auth/policy.go b/auth/policy.go
--- a/auth/policy.go
+++ b/auth/policy.go
@@ -4 +4 @@
-const maxAttempts = 10
+const maxAttempts = 5

cases.message:
Limit bulk exports to ten thousand rows

Use the limit that Finance approved in yesterday's meeting.

Keep webhook retries below the gateway limit

Follow the temporary workaround from INC-427 until the gateway team responds.

Set resident cache expiration

Use the same cache policy as the other service.

Expire password reset tokens after ten minutes

The expiration changes from one hour to ten minutes.

Stop failed rent payments after three attempts

The worker now stops after the third gateway error.

Reject legacy lease identifiers

Requests with a legacy identifier now return HTTP 400.

Prevent duplicate invoice delivery

Changed retry.go, worker.go, and three queue helper functions.

Restore resident search results

Refactored SearchController, replaced two mocks, and moved query construction into search/sql.go.

Keep lease imports stable

Renamed ImportRunner, split ParserFactory, and added a branch in LeaseRowMapper.

Route M2 residents through the red lane

The red lane now applies before the renewal offer is created.

Use a turtle hold for renewal offers

A turtle hold now pauses the offer before a manager can approve it.

Respect the Nori cutoff for flex leases

Flex leases now stop at the Nori cutoff instead of the standard date.
Increase the session timeout to sixty minutes
cases.diff:
diff --git a/session.go b/session.go
--- a/session.go
+++ b/session.go
@@ -2 +2 @@
-const timeoutMinutes = 60
+const timeoutMinutes = 30
